refit: quarterly, before the first decision of the quarter
representation: close price, min-max using only each training window; no clipping
execution: market order at next observed open after one additional completed hourly bar
long_rule: accepted terminal prediction / observed close - 1 > 0.003; otherwise cash
selection_rule: Validation only: minimize mean quarterly daily ES95 loss + 0.5*standard deviation of quarterly ES95; constraints mean exposure>=10%, >=12 entries overall and every quarter exposure>=2%. Tie-break larger net return then trial number. If no trial qualifies, report failed eligibility and choose the least total normalized constraint violation, then objective; never call zero-activity low risk a success.
ablations: same trajectory model with cm: no growth rejection, missing-neighbor rejection retained
forced nearest-motif avg: different aggregator, no neighbor-radius rejection
exposure_controls: causal daily-rebalanced buy-hold fraction equal to lagged trailing90 daily ADIS target fractions
retrospective daily-rebalanced constant-target buy-hold, diagnostic only; realized exposure reported
primary_comparison: Daily ES95 loss: ADIS minus causal exposure-matched buy-hold. Negative difference favors ADIS.
robustness: seeds 7 and 123 for the selected configuration
missing_bars: Causally forward-fill prior close and set zero volume on the model hourly grid; record every missing bar. A context containing a missing bar sets target=cash; close at the next eligible real open. The trading engine receives only real exchange candles, so no synthetic-price fills. Zero-volume archive placeholders are unobserved and nontradable.
terminal_policy: Schedule liquidation before the last observed open; do not rely on platform finalize_trades semantics.
scope: Research demonstration on one liquid crypto instrument. Trading policy is new; user explicitly authorized tuning motif/Wishart/forecast hyperparameters. Published geometry remains a separate control. Statistical outcomes, including negative findings, remain reportable; test results never tune parameters.

optimization.method: Optuna constrained TPE, four chronological quarterly validation folds in 2021

es_estimator: Mean of the worst ceil(0.05*n) daily returns, sign inverted and floored at zero; used identically in selection and bootstrap.
audit_pilot: Initial validation-only engineering run stopped after3 complete trials to add cache/provenance guards and daily exposure-control rebalancing. No test results were computed. Fresh32-trial study follows v3.
